title: Total degree of a finite product
statement: Let $\sigma$ and $\iota$ be types, let $S$ be a finite subset of $\iota$, and assign a real multivariate polynomial $P_i$ in variables indexed by $\sigma$ to each $i\in\iota$. If every $P_i$ with $i\in S$ is nonzero, then the total degree of their product is the sum of their total degrees.
hypotheses_covered: Each $P_i$ is a multivariate polynomial over $\mathbb R$ in variables indexed by $\sigma$
